name: biblio-downloaded-epub-read-journey
comment: Hostile Lanista regression probe for commit 38339f4 ("fix(biblio): stabilize downloaded book read journey"). Isolated tagged session, unique pipe, Drive enabled, never the daily pipe. Seed: tests/lanista-seeds/biblio-downloaded-epub-v1 (a real tiny EPUB + a books/index.json whose recorded path is intentionally STALE with a filename matching the seeded copy, so BookDownloader self-heals the path on boot; plus a durable collection-store.ini carrying the book's Collection entry, because the one-time boot backfill that would surface a downloaded book in the Biblio Library runs against ProfileStoreRuntime's SEALED placeholder and is discarded on 'continue local' — see the seed's provenance note). Proves the two halves of the fix live: (1) the detail page resolves localPath from Books.downloadedBooks() by normalized title+author even though the live source inventory is empty/irrelevant, shows "Ready on this device", and Read opens the reader without starting a replacement acquisition; (2) the same EPUB surfaces in Downloads and its named Read opens the reader on the same local path. bookReaderShell + biblioBookDetail objectNames are test-only seams (no product behavior change). Run: lanista session run <this.json> --exe <abs colosseum.exe> --qml <abs qml/Main.qml> --seed <abs seed dir> --tag biblioepubfix --drive --ready-ms 90000
